# Staff AI Engineer — Ravenmoor Analytics (fictional)

Ravenmoor Analytics builds research assistants for investment analysts. London, hybrid.

## Requirements

- 8+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building LLM products.
- Python and TypeScript.
- Designing retrieval systems with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
- Running offline and online evaluations of model quality.
- Leading projects across several teams.

## Nice to have

- Fine-tuning open-weight models.
- Experience in finance.
- Rust.

Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available.
